title: Guitar Hero II arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2006, Guitar Hero II became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2006, Guitar Hero II became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the music category, Guitar Hero II broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
